themes.description: Covers feedback on the overall ease of use, intuitiveness, and general user experience of the application.
Feedback related to specific trading functionalities, tools, indicators, and feature requests within the trading platform.
Feedback and requests related to the availability of the application in different languages and localization features.
Reviews where users ask questions about how to use the app, its features, or trading rules.
Requests for new features, enhancements, or missing functionalities within the application.
Problems related to account creation, activation, verification, or general access.
This theme covers issues related to opening, closing, or managing user accounts, including difficulties with account deletion or modification.
Feedback concerning the app's design, layout, navigation, and overall user experience.
This theme covers user requests for new features, services, or functionalities that are currently unavailable on the platform.
This theme covers feedback related to app updates, installation, storage, or general application maintenance issues.
Covers feedback related to the ease of use, intuitiveness, and overall satisfaction with the application's design and functionality.
Captures general positive or negative sentiment about the service or application that doesn't fit into specific functional themes.
Addresses concerns related to data security, account safety, fraudulent activities, and the overall trustworthiness of the platform.
Reviews related to alleged fraudulent activities, trust issues, or concerns about the platform's integrity and ethical practices.
Reviews concerning the availability, accuracy, or clarity of financial reports, statements, profit/loss calculations, and tax-related documents.
Feedback on the overall design, usability, and changes to app features or user interface after updates.
This theme covers user concerns regarding the safety of their funds, data privacy, account security, and overall trust in the platform's security measures.
This theme covers feedback related to the application's user interface, navigation, layout, and overall user experience design. It includes suggestions for improving usability and accessibility.
This theme covers feedback related to the availability, depth, and range of features within the application, including comparisons to competitors.
